scope: physics-based evaluation of teacher-forced ACT-generated G1 trajectories

event_definitions.LEFT_LIFT_SUCCESS: left-hand contact AND COM rise >= 0.03 m AND no table support, continuously for >= 0.5 s
event_definitions.LEFT_HOLD_SUCCESS: after LEFT_LIFT_SUCCESS, the object stays elevated and table-unsupported with left retention for >= 0.5 s
event_definitions.HANDOFF_SUCCESS: right acquisition precedes left release; after left release the object remains elevated, table-unsupported, and right-retained for >= 0.5 s
event_definitions.RIGHT_TRANSPORT_SUCCESS: after right ownership the right-retained object enters the frozen bin-approach target volume for >= 0.2 s
event_definitions.RELEASE_SUCCESS: the right hand is open, right support is absent, the object enters the frozen bin interior, and remains settled there for >= 0.5 s
event_definitions.FULL_PHYSICAL_SUCCESS: LEFT_LIFT_SUCCESS AND HANDOFF_SUCCESS AND RIGHT_TRANSPORT_SUCCESS AND RELEASE_SUCCESS
